tasks.title: Project Setup and Database Schema Implementation
tasks.description: Initialize Spring Boot backend, React frontend projects, configure MySQL database, and implement complete database schema with all entities and relationships
tasks.details:
BACKEND:
- Initialize Spring Boot 3.x project with dependencies: spring-boot-starter-web, spring-boot-starter-data-jpa, spring-boot-starter-security, mysql-connector-j, jjwt-api/impl/jackson (0.12.x), spring-boot-starter-validation, lombok
- Configure application.yml with dev/prod profiles for MySQL connection (Railway)
- Create JPA entities with proper relationships:
  * User (id, name, email UNIQUE, password, phone, role ENUM(USER/ADMIN), createdAt)
  * Restaurant (id, name, description, address, cuisineType, rating, imageUrl, createdAt)
  * Category (id, name)
  * FoodItem (id, restaurantId FK, categoryId FK, name, description, price, imageUrl, isAvailable)
  * Cart (id, userId FK UNIQUE, restaurantId FK)
  * CartItem (id, cartId FK, foodItemId FK, quantity)
  * Order (id, userId FK, restaurantId FK, addressId FK, totalAmount, status ENUM, createdAt)
  * OrderItem (id, orderId FK, foodItemId FK, quantity, priceAtOrder)
  * Address (id, userId FK, label, fullAddress, city, pincode)
- Use @OneToMany, @ManyToOne, cascade types, orphanRemoval appropriately
- Add indexes on foreign keys and email
- Create layered package structure: controller, service, repository, entity, dto, config, security, exception

FRONTEND:
- Initialize React 18+ with Vite
- Install dependencies: react-router-dom, axios, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer
- Configure Tailwind CSS with custom breakpoints (mobile 360px, tablet 768px, desktop 1440px)
- Create folder structure: src/components, src/pages, src/services, src/contexts, src/utils, src/hooks
- Setup axios instance with baseURL pointing to backend API
- Create environment variable files (.env.development, .env.production)

DATABASE:
- Create MySQL database schema with proper constraints, foreign keys, and indexes
- Write SQL migration scripts or use Flyway/Liquibase for version control
tasks.testStrategy:
- Verify Spring Boot application starts without errors
- Verify React application compiles and runs
- Test database connection from Spring Boot
- Verify all JPA entities map correctly (use schema validation: validate)
- Run SQL queries to confirm all tables created with correct relationships
- Test Tailwind CSS configuration renders properly

tasks.title: Authentication System with JWT and Spring Security
tasks.description: Implement complete authentication system with user registration, login, JWT token generation/validation, and Spring Security configuration for role-based access control
tasks.details:
BACKEND:
- Configure Spring Security 6.x with JWT authentication filter chain
- Create JwtUtil class:
  * generateToken(UserDetails) using HMAC-SHA256, store userId and role in claims, 24h expiry
  * validateToken(token) verify signature and expiration
  * extractUsername(token) parse claims
- Implement UserDetailsService loading user by email
- Create JwtAuthenticationFilter extending OncePerRequestFilter:
  * Extract JWT from Authorization: Bearer header
  * Validate and set SecurityContextHolder authentication
- Configure SecurityFilterChain:
  * Disable CSRF (stateless API)
  * Permit /api/auth/**, /api/restaurants/**, /api/restaurants/{id}/menu (public)
  * Require authentication for /api/cart/**, /api/orders/**, /api/users/**
  * Require ADMIN role for /api/admin/**
- Create AuthController:
  * POST /api/auth/register: validate input (email format, password min 8 chars), hash password with BCryptPasswordEncoder strength 10, save User with role=USER, return success message
  * POST /api/auth/login: authenticate credentials, generate JWT, return {token, userId, name, role}
- Create DTOs: RegisterRequest, LoginRequest, AuthResponse
- Implement @ControllerAdvice GlobalExceptionHandler for BadCredentialsException, DuplicateEmailException, ValidationException

FRONTEND:
- Create AuthContext with React Context API:
  * State: {user: {id, name, email, role}, token, isAuthenticated}
  * Methods: login(email, password), register(userData), logout(), checkAuth()
  * Store token in localStorage, set axios default header: Authorization: Bearer {token}
- Create pages/Register.jsx:
  * Form: name, email, phone, password, confirmPassword
  * Client validation: email regex, password match, phone format
  * On submit: call /api/auth/register, show success/error message, redirect to login
- Create pages/Login.jsx:
  * Form: email, password
  * On submit: call /api/auth/login, store token and user in AuthContext, redirect to home
- Create ProtectedRoute component wrapping routes requiring authentication
- Create AdminRoute component checking role === 'ADMIN'
- Implement auto-logout on 401 response (axios interceptor)
tasks.testStrategy:
- Unit test JwtUtil token generation and validation
- Test registration with valid/invalid inputs (duplicate email, weak password)
- Test login with correct/incorrect credentials
- Test JWT expiry handling
- Verify protected endpoints reject requests without token (401)
- Verify admin endpoints reject USER role requests (403)
- Test frontend: successful registration → login → token stored → authenticated requests succeed
- Test logout clears token and redirects to login

tasks.title: Shopping Cart APIs and Business Logic
tasks.description: Implement cart management APIs with single-restaurant constraint, cart item CRUD operations, and automatic total calculation
tasks.details:
BACKEND:
- Create CartRepository extending JpaRepository<Cart, Long>:
  * findByUserId(Long userId) return Optional<Cart>
- Create CartItemRepository extending JpaRepository<CartItem, Long>:
  * findByCartId(Long cartId)
  * findByCartIdAndFoodItemId(Long cartId, Long foodItemId)
- Create CartService:
  * getOrCreateCart(Long userId) find existing or create new empty cart
  * addItemToCart(Long userId, Long foodItemId, int quantity):
    - Validate food item exists and isAvailable
    - Get user's cart
    - Check if cart.restaurantId is null or matches food item's restaurant
    - If different restaurant, throw "Cart can only contain items from one restaurant. Clear cart first?"
    - If same/null, set cart.restaurantId
    - Check if item already in cart: update quantity (add), else create new CartItem
    - Return updated CartDTO with items and total
  * updateCartItem(Long userId, Long cartItemId, int quantity):
    - Validate cartItem belongs to user's cart
    - If quantity <= 0, delete CartItem
    - Else update quantity
  * removeCartItem(Long userId, Long cartItemId) delete CartItem
  * clearCart(Long userId) delete all CartItems, set cart.restaurantId = null
  * calculateTotal(Cart cart) sum of (item.foodItem.price * item.quantity) for all items
- Create CartController:
  * GET /api/cart: return current user's cart with {restaurantId, restaurantName, items: [{cartItemId, foodItemId, name, price, quantity, subtotal}], total}
  * POST /api/cart/items: body {foodItemId, quantity}, add to cart
  * PUT /api/cart/items/{cartItemId}: body {quantity}, update quantity
  * DELETE /api/cart/items/{cartItemId}: remove item
  * DELETE /api/cart: clear entire cart
- Extract authenticated user ID from SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication()
- Create DTOs: CartDTO, CartItemDTO, AddToCartRequest
tasks.testStrategy:
- Test add item to empty cart creates cart and sets restaurantId
- Test add item from same restaurant succeeds
- Test add item from different restaurant fails with clear error message
- Test add existing item increments quantity instead of creating duplicate
- Test update quantity to 0 removes item
- Test remove item decreases cart size
- Test clear cart removes all items and resets restaurantId
- Test total calculation accuracy with multiple items and quantities
- Test cart operations fail for unauthenticated users (401)
- Test cartItem belongs to requesting user (prevent cross-user access)

tasks.title: Order Placement and Checkout APIs
tasks.description: Implement checkout flow and order placement APIs with cart-to-order conversion, order status management, and cart clearing
tasks.details:
BACKEND:
- Create OrderRepository extending JpaRepository<Order, Long>:
  * findByUserId(Long userId, Pageable pageable) for order history
  * findByUserIdAndId(Long userId, Long orderId) for ownership verification
- Create OrderItemRepository extending JpaRepository<OrderItem, Long>
- Create OrderService:
  * placeOrder(Long userId, Long addressId):
    - Get user's cart and validate not empty
    - Validate address exists and belongs to user
    - Validate all cart items still available
    - Calculate total from cart
    - Create Order entity: {userId, restaurantId from cart, addressId, totalAmount, status: PLACED, createdAt: now}
    - For each CartItem, create OrderItem: {orderId, foodItemId, quantity, priceAtOrder: current food item price}
    - Save order and orderItems
    - Clear cart (delete cart items, reset cart.restaurantId)
    - Return OrderDTO with order ID and confirmation
  * getUserOrders(Long userId, int page, int size) return paginated order history, sorted by createdAt DESC
  * getOrderById(Long userId, Long orderId):
    - Verify order belongs to user
    - Return order with items: {orderId, restaurantName, totalAmount, status, createdAt, deliveryAddress, items: [{foodItemName, quantity, priceAtOrder, subtotal}]}
- Create OrderController:
  * POST /api/orders: body {addressId}, place order from cart
  * GET /api/orders?page=0&size=10: return user's order history
  * GET /api/orders/{orderId}: return order details
- Create order status ENUM: PLACED, CONFIRMED, PREPARING, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, CANCELLED
- Create DTOs: PlaceOrderRequest, OrderDTO, OrderItemDTO, OrderDetailDTO
tasks.testStrategy:
- Test place order with valid cart and address succeeds
- Test place order with empty cart fails (400)
- Test place order with non-existent addressId fails (404)
- Test place order with address from different user fails (403)
- Test order items capture price at time of order (priceAtOrder)
- Test cart is cleared after successful order placement

- Test order details include all items with correct calculations
- Test user cannot access another user's order (403)
- Test pagination works correctly for users with many orders

tasks.title: Frontend: Authentication Pages and Protected Routes
tasks.description: Build login, registration pages, and implement route protection with JWT token management
tasks.details:
COMPONENTS:
- Create pages/Login.jsx:
  * Form: email, password
  * Client validation: email format, required fields
  * Submit: call AuthContext.login(email, password)
  * Show loading state during submission (disable button, spinner)
  * Display error message on failed login
  * On success: redirect to returnUrl or home
  * "Don't have an account? Register" link
  * "Forgot Password?" link (placeholder for future)
- Create pages/Register.jsx:
  * Form: name, email, phone, password, confirm password
  * Client validation:
    - All fields required
    - Email format (regex)
    - Phone format (10 digits)
    - Password min 8 chars, match confirmation
  * Submit: POST /api/auth/register
  * Show field-level errors
  * On success: show success message, redirect to login
  * "Already have an account? Login" link
- Update AuthContext:
  * Initialize: check localStorage for token, validate with backend
  * login(email, password):
    - POST /api/auth/login
    - Store token in localStorage
    - Set axios default header: axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`
    - Update context state: {user, token, isAuthenticated: true}
  * logout():
    - Clear localStorage
    - Remove axios header
    - Reset context state

tasks.title: Error Handling, Validation, and Polish
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive error handling, input validation, loading states, and UX polish across the entire application
tasks.details:
BACKEND:
- Enhance GlobalExceptionHandler (@ControllerAdvice):
  * Handle MethodArgumentNotValidException: return 400 with field errors
  * Handle EntityNotFoundException: return 404 with message
  * Handle AccessDeniedException: return 403
  * Handle DataIntegrityViolationException: return 409 for duplicates
  * Handle generic Exception: return 500 with safe message (log full stack trace)
  * Response format: {timestamp, status, error, message, path, fieldErrors[]}
- Add @Valid and validation annotations to all DTOs:
  * @NotBlank, @NotNull, @Email, @Size, @Min, @Max, @Pattern
  * Custom validators: @ValidPhoneNumber, @ValidPassword
- Implement request/response logging filter for debugging
- Add CORS configuration for frontend domain
- Configure rate limiting for auth endpoints (prevent brute force)

FRONTEND:
- Create components/LoadingSpinner.jsx: reusable spinner component
- Create components/ErrorMessage.jsx: reusable error display

- Implement global error boundary (ErrorBoundary component) catching React errors
- Add loading states to all async operations:
  * Skeleton loaders for lists/cards
  * Button disabled with spinner during submission
  * Full-page loader for navigation
- Add empty states:
  * Empty cart: illustration + "Start browsing" CTA
  * No orders: "Order your first meal" CTA
  * No search results: "Try different keywords"
  * No restaurants: "Coming soon to your area"
- Enhance form validation:

  * Delete address, clear cart, cancel order
- Implement optimistic updates where appropriate:

  * Lazy load routes with React.lazy() and Suspense
  * Debounce search inputs

tasks.title: Database Seeding, Documentation, and Deployment
tasks.description: Create database seed scripts, comprehensive documentation, and deploy application to Vercel, Render, and Railway
tasks.details:
DATABASE SEEDING:
- Create data.sql or use Spring Boot CommandLineRunner:
  * Seed categories: North Indian, South Indian, Chinese, Italian, Mexican, Desserts, Beverages
  * Seed 15-20 restaurants with realistic data across categories
  * Seed 5-10 food items per restaurant with varied prices
  * Create 1 admin user (email: admin@foodrush.com, password: Admin@123)
  * Create 2-3 test users
  * Seed sample addresses for test users
  * Optionally seed sample orders for testing order history
- Ensure seed script is idempotent (check existence before insert)

DOCUMENTATION:
- Create comprehensive README.md:
  * Project overview and features
  * Tech stack with versions
  * Architecture diagram (optional)
  * Prerequisites (Node.js 18+, Java 17+, MySQL 8+)
  * Environment variables required:
    - Backend: DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, JWT_EXPIRATION
    - Frontend: VITE_API_BASE_URL
  * Local setup instructions:
    - Clone repo
    - Database setup and seeding
    - Backend setup (./mvnw spring-boot:run)
    - Frontend setup (npm install && npm run dev)
  * API documentation (link to Postman collection or Swagger)
  * Demo credentials (admin and user)
  * Deployment instructions
  * Screenshots of main features
  * Known limitations and future enhancements
  * License
- Create API_DOCUMENTATION.md:
  * Document all endpoints with request/response examples
  * Authentication flow
  * Error response formats
- Create .env.example files for both frontend and backend
- Add inline code comments for complex logic

DEPLOYMENT:
- Backend (Render):
  * Create Render Web Service
  * Connect GitHub repo
  * Build command: ./mvnw clean package -DskipTests
  * Start command: java -jar target/foodrush-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar
  * Set environment variables: DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET
  * Configure health check endpoint: /actuator/health
- Database (Railway):
  * Create MySQL instance on Railway
  * Note connection string (DATABASE_URL)
  * Run seed scripts via Railway CLI or initial migration
- Frontend (Vercel):
  * Connect GitHub repo to Vercel
  * Set build command: npm run build
  * Set output directory: dist
  * Set environment variable: VITE_API_BASE_URL (Render backend URL)
  * Configure redirects for SPA routing (vercel.json)
- Post-deployment:
  * Test complete user flow on production
  * Verify CORS configuration allows Vercel domain
  * Test admin functionality
  * Check mobile responsiveness on real devices
  * Monitor logs for errors

CONFIGURATION FILES:
- Create vercel.json:
  ```json
  {
    "rewrites": [{"source": "/(.*)", "destination": "/index.html"}]
  }
  ```
- Update application.yml with production profile
- Create .gitignore excluding .env, target/, node_modules/, build/

FINAL TESTING:
- End-to-end testing on deployed environment
- Performance testing (page load times, API response times)
- Security audit (OWASP top 10 checks)
- Mobile responsiveness check on multiple devices
- Cross-browser testing (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
